caption: The plug of a full bathtub is pulled, and as the water drains a swirling whirlpool forms over the drain.

sa.check: A full bathtub has its plug pulled.
A swirling whirlpool forms over the drain.
The plug comes out first and the whirlpool forms after.

pc.expect: The level falls steadily and a dimple over the drain deepens into a funnel that grows as the water gets shallower.
pc.fail: The level rises; or the funnel shrinks as the water gets lower; or it drains and then refills.

pc.expect: The spin is at the drain, and the water does not spin without draining.
pc.fail: It spins with the plug in; or spins away from the drain; or the whole tub churns.

pc.expect: The water goes down the drain.
pc.fail: It goes up; or out over the rim; or floats.

pc.expect: The surface is liquid, dimpling into a funnel.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or beads; or is solid.

pc.expect: One tub keeps its shape and the drain stays where it is.
pc.fail: The drain moves; or the tub duplicates; or water appears from nowhere.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tub and the bathroom stay the same.
pc.fail: The tub changes colour; or the tiles change; or the room rearranges.
